verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals turns incoming events into Alerts only when CEL-based Alert Rules match, with backtesting. An Alerting Analytics page shows how events become alerts and then incidents. This gives some noise control, but the evidence never describes deduplicating repeat events or grouping related alerts into one page. missing for 10: explicit deduplication of duplicate events, grouping/correlation of related alerts into a single alert or incident, documented guarantee that one incident pages one responder, independent or hands-on corroboration.
